item.title: ERC Synergy Grant 2027: Everything Research Groups Need to Know
item.description: The ERC Synergy Grant funds groups of 2–4 PIs with up to €10 million over 6 years. The 2026 call has closed; the 2027 call opens summer 2026. Here’s everything research groups need to know.

item.title: ERC Starting Grant 2027: Everything Early-Career Researchers Need to Know
item.description: The ERC Starting Grant offers up to €1.5 million over 5 years for early-career researchers. The 2026 call has closed but the 2027 call brings major eligibility changes. Here’s everything you need to know.

item.title: ERC Advanced Grant 2026: Everything Established Researchers Need to Know
item.description: The ERC Advanced Grant offers up to €2.5 million over 5 years for established research leaders. The 2026 call opens 28 May with a deadline of 27 August 2026. Here’s your complete guide.

item.title: How to Restore a Single WordPress Page from a WP Engine Backup (Without Restoring the Whole Site)
item.description: WordPress doesn't let you restore a single page from a full-site backup. Here's the exact workflow I used to extract one page from a WP Engine database dump and push it back via the REST API — without touching the rest of the site.

item.title: Villum Investigator 2026: Grant Quick Reference
item.description: The Villum Investigator 2026 call is open — DKK 300 million available for experienced researchers in technical and natural sciences at Danish institutions. Deadline: 20 August 2026.

item.title: How to Connect Claude Desktop to Google Sheets via MCP: A Complete Setup Guide
item.description: Step-by-step guide to connecting Claude Desktop to Google Sheets using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Covers OAuth and service account setup, configuration, and troubleshooting common errors.

item.title: 16 European Research Funding Calls Open in 2026
item.description: 16 European research funding calls in 2026 — ERC, EIC, NWO, UKRI, NNF, and Villum Fonden. Deadlines, budgets, and eligibility at a glance.

item.title: ERC Guidelines on AI in Grant Proposal Evaluation: What Reviewers (and Applicants) Need to Know
item.description: The ERC has published official guidelines on AI use in grant evaluation. Here's what reviewers must follow—and what it means for how you write your proposal. (155 chars)

item.title: NotebookLM Cinematic Video Overviews: What's new and is it worth it?
item.description: Google just upgraded NotebookLM's video feature. Cinematic Video Overviews use Gemini, Imagen, and Veo to generate animated explainer videos from your sources — no blank canvas needed. Here's what changed and what still needs work.

item.title: How to Automate Event Registration with Stripe, Make.com and MailerLite: A Step-by-Step Guide
item.description: Step-by-step guide to building an automated event registration workflow using Stripe, Make.com and MailerLite — no manual work, no missed onboarding emails.
